work.description: Brief XXXVII raises Marino to the rank of city, still subject to Albano; LF7325 ut → LF7331 ab alteris across running-title part LF7328; LF7391 → LF7406 across provenance, signature line, mark and page number LF7394–7403; complete 3 June 1835 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF7302–7302; the source closing at LF7430–7433 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die tertia iunii mil- lesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quinto, ponti- ficatus Nostri anno quinto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
